notes: Two branches meet at Ibn Jurayj: the first by «ح» and the second by «جميعا عن عبد الرزاق»; the text writes «حدثنا عبد الرزاق، أخبرنا ابن جريج» again for the second branch
Written once after the convergence: Ibn Abi Mulayka, Dhakwan (named as «مولى عائشة» only in description), Aisha
«- واللفظ لابن رافع -» is an editor's gloss, left out
